title: Dispatch state
description: The durable record of one open delegation. It lives at <workspace>/.root-architect/state/dispatch-<run_id>.json and is the run's only active signal: a dispatch with status 'open' under that directory IS an in-flight delegation, and its absence is the terminal signal. There is no separate marker file. Both PreToolUse hooks re-read this file on every call rather than caching, so closing a dispatch takes effect immediately.

status.description: Created 'open' by scripts/dispatch_state.py open; moved to 'closed' when the worker's return has been validated and adjudicated, or 'aborted' on a stop condition. Only root runs that script — a worker that could close its own dispatch could unlock root's guard rails.

outcome.description: Required once status leaves 'open', so a dispatch is never quietly dropped without saying how it ended.
